events.verdict: Christie (DAL) shuffles toward Maxey's (PHI) path and the contact as the two come together at the same spot on the perimeter is marginal.
Marshall (DAL) initiates illegal contact across Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) left arm as he tips the ball in.
Irving (DAL) firms up in a legal guarding position in Embiid's (PHI) path and is dislodged from his position.
Maxey (PHI) and Irving (DAL) mutually engage and disengage with one another at the top of the perimeter.
Edwards' (DAL) hands come forward when he sets the pick on Maxey (PHI) and he releases away from Maxey's upper body as marginal contact occurs.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Marshall (DAL) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to PHI.
Embiid (PHI) grasps and then releases Thompson's (DAL) left arm as the entry pass into the post is made.
Irving (DAL) moves into Maxey's (PHI) space and the contact to Maxey's front and side has minimal effect on his SQBR.
Marshall (DAL) makes clean initial contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Maxey (PHI) prior to incidental contact occurring.
Edwards (PHI) makes clean contact with the ball that causes it to become loose during Marshall's (DAL) driving shot attempt and as he follows through, there is marginal contact with Marshall's arm.
Embiid (PHI) releases his right hand away from Irving's (DAL) side and marginal contact occurs as the two attempt to establish rebounding position.
Irving (DAL) initiates illegal contact across Embiid's (PHI) right wrist before making contact with the ball.
Irving (DAL) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds.
Edwards (DAL) and Yabusele (PHI) mutually engage and disengage with one another during the inbound.
Marshall (DAL) and Embiid (PHI) mutually engage and disengage with one another as they move around the screen.
Thompson (DAL) is raising his left arm into a vertical position while jumping alongside Embiid (PHI) and the contact that occurs during Embiid's layup attempt is marginal.
Yabusele (PHI) is moving to align alongside Marshall's (DAL) path and the contact as the two come together at the same point is marginal.
Thompson (DAL) initiates contact across Embiid's (PHI) left arm following the change of possession.
Embiid (PHI) and Christie (DAL) engage and disengage with one another during the inbound.
Embiid (PHI) pivots out toward the sideline and incidental contact occurs with Exum (DAL).
Exum (DAL) commits a take foul on Embiid (PHI).
Marshall (DAL) has a grasp of Yabusele's (PHI) jersey and the contact that occurs during the rebound is marginal.
Edwards (PHI) commits a take foul on Irving (DAL).
Edwards (PHI) trails behind Irving (DAL) and Irving's momentum is carrying him forwards as he receives the pass. The contact that occurs on the play is marginal.
After Exum (DAL) has already started to mishandle the ball on his own, Embiid (PHI) makes clean contact with it to fully dislodge it away. The ensuing contact is incidental.
